title: Multimodal Support in Gen AI Studio Playground
assumptions: Jira was unreachable from this environment; the RFE was taken from the local snapshot .artifacts/RHAISTRAT-1527/rfe-snapshot.md (Step 1 local-artifact path). The snapshot's Jira key and URL are used as provenance.
The source is a strategy document (RHAISTRAT-1527, derived from RHAIRFE-913), so the scope follows its MVP and P0/P1 requirements, not a single RFE.
Out of scope and not prototyped: video, PDF as image input, microphone capture, audio output or playback, streaming, multiple images or mixed image plus audio per conversation, chat persistence.
Capability tag names image-inferencing and audio-asr are the names the RFE proposes; the model registry team has not confirmed them. Mock model tags use those names.

The audio-asr tag on a primary model is treated as the gate for showing the audio control. The RFE is not explicit on this point; the ASR dropdown is populated from AI Assets flagged as transcription endpoints.
Model names (Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-Omni-7B, Granite-3.3-8B-Instruct, whisper-large-v3) are illustrative mock catalog entries, not verified RHOAI registry contents.
Proposed 10 MB file size limit for images and audio (RFE default) is used pending PM confirmation. Accepted MIME types: image/jpeg, image/png, audio/wav, audio/mpeg.
No backend exists in the prototype. Send produces a mock reply, and ASR failure and empty-transcript states are scenario-driven, not computed.
Persona ids (ai-engineer, platform-admin) are plain labels; knowledge/personas/catalog.yaml is not present in this checkout.
Decision mode is skip, so no decision pages were generated.
